description: Search AI inference offerings in the OpenNodes registry — registered nodes AND imported catalogs (OpenRouter, Hugging Face Inference Providers, models.dev, local nodes). All filters are optional and combine with AND. Returns { offerings, total, counts }: each offering has node_id, offering_id, model, pricing (USD per MTok), trust tier, serving capabilities, measured probe results, and a rank explanation. Use get_offering for one offering's full card, recommend to let the advisor choose.

exclude_lineage.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes; drops offerings whose declared model lineage includes any of them, e.g. "CN". Offerings that declare no lineage are kept unless lineage is "declared".

family.description: Model family or exact artifact, e.g. "llama-3.3" or "qwen3". Matches model.family or model.artifact exactly.

jurisdiction.description: Only operators that declare a country inside it: "eea" (EU + Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway) or comma-separated ISO country codes, e.g. "DE,FI". Registered nodes declare their country; imported listings of known providers carry an inferred one (jurisdiction.basis = "inferred"); listings without a country are excluded.

lang.description: Language with minimum grade, "<iso-code>[:basic|strong|native]", e.g. "pl:strong" or "de".

limit.description: Maximum offerings to return; `total` still counts every match.

lineage.description: "declared": drop offerings whose model declares no lineage (unknown origin is not clean). Combine with exclude_lineage for a strict origin policy.

local.description: true: only models that run on the user's own machine (the Ollama library: no server, free, ranked by Ollama pulls, with local.sizes_memory per size). false: only hosted offerings. Omit for both (hosted listed first). The result's counts give { hosted, local }.

location_basis.description: Minimum evidence for the serving locations: claimed < documented (the provider's own dated page) < measured (registry probes) < attested. Offerings without known locations are excluded.

max_input_price.description: Maximum input price in USD per million tokens.

memory_gb.description: RAM/VRAM the user can give a local model, in GB: keeps local models with a size that fits (4-bit estimate). Hosted offerings are unaffected.

min_context.description: Minimum context window in tokens, e.g. 32768.

modality.description: What the model consumes/produces. Use "text" for chat and completion models.

no_training.description: true: only offerings whose data_policy says training_on_inputs is false. Offerings without a data_policy are excluded.

q.description: Free-text match against the model metadata, offering id, and node id, e.g. "bielik" or "coder".

region.description: Data residency: every pinned region and every live serving site must lie inside this ISO 3166 code, e.g. "CA" (also matches "CA-QC") or "EU" (also matches member states such as "DE"; "EEA" adds IS, LI, NO).

retention.description: Maximum data retention: "none" keeps offerings whose data_policy stores nothing beyond the request; "ephemeral" also allows bounded holding. Offerings without a data_policy are excluded.

scheme.description: Payment scheme the offering must accept. "free" finds no-cost offerings.

sort.description: rank = registry ranking (price, trust, reliability); price = cheapest input first; ttft = fastest first token; tps = highest throughput.

supports.description: Comma-separated features the offering must all support: tool_calls, json_mode, vision, streaming. Example: "tool_calls,json_mode".

tier.description: Minimum trust tier. unverified < community (passed automated checks) < verified (identity and context verified) < attested.

trust.description: "trusted": only the trusted pool, for personal data and sensitive work: operators in the registry's trusted jurisdictions (see /v0/health trust), declared lineage without CN, tier verified or higher, no retention and no training on inputs. "open" (or omitted): both pools. Each result carries pool: "trusted" or "open".
